title: Incorrect package name in version lookup
detail: The __getattr__ implementation returns the version of the 'werkzeug' package instead of 'jinja2', causing the deprecation warning to provide the wrong version number.

title: Potential crash on None response
detail: If `response` is None, accessing `response.flags` raises AttributeError, causing the timeout handler to crash.

title: Incorrect width returned for non-printable characters
detail: When the table entry width is -1 (indicating a non-printable or zero-width character), the code now returns -1 instead of 0. This causes callers to receive a negative width, which is invalid and can lead to layout errors.
